title: The hacked web shop
summary: NimbuMart's web server is busy and sending data out. Follow the attacker from SQL injection to a web shell, a hidden backdoor and a command server.
ctf: The attacker signed their notes with a crew tag (step 7). Submit it on the CTF board as "Follow the beacon home".

playbook.trigger: Alerts for SSH brute force, a web shell request or a process running from /tmp on the web server
decisions: Take the shop offline or keep it running behind a block?
Rotate every credential on the box, or only the deploy account?
targets: Remove the web shell and cron job within 2 hours
notify: CERT-In within 6 hours of noticing it (2022 Directions)
Payment provider, if card data could have been reached
done: Web shell, cron entry and /tmp/.x removed
Upload form fixed and passwords rotated
/etc/shadow treated as stolen: every password changed
